name: Outdoor front apron south of the drawn front wall (not sales floor, not even inside the building). geometry.json's boundary does NOT trace the front wall: its last edge is a single straight run from (949.6,678.9) to (134.5,720.3), so between x=140 and x=500 the polygon dips 14-31 pt SOUTH of the wall and admits the sidewalk. The wall is drawn as the band [163.0,682.2,301.8,686.6] continued by the entrance door band [304.8,683.7,357.2,686.5], then east of the doorway as the heavy run at y=700-702 from x=367 to x=595 (the west end of the same wall is the boundary's own vertex (74.08,688.9)). Everything the polygon added below it is exterior: the walled cart/propane enclosure x=80-140 y=688-721, the sidewalk racks [141.9,691.8,279.5,702.3] and [142.6,721.5,276.4,730.8] and [278.3,720.8,310.4,727.9], and the apron in front of the doors. It was reachable — the front doors are an opening, so the flood filled the sidewalk — and the ENTRANCE anchor (331.4,707.3) itself sat on it, i.e. every route started outside the building. North edge held at y=688 (flush under the wall band's y=686.6 south face) out to x=372, then at y=701 (flush under the y=700-702 wall) out to x=500; east of x=500 the boundary diagonal already runs at or above the drawn wall (deepest walkable row y=698 against a wall at y=700) so there is nothing left to seal there

Bakery back-of-house inside the counter ring (staff). The 'Bakery' title (851.4,230.4) is printed in a 64x160 pt pocket that holds NO fixture and NO product label, ringed by the bakery cases/walls: west wall [803.8,158.3,814.7,298.7], south case [817.5,290.9,854.7,300.7], the SE chamfer poly (878.6,265.4)-(855.6,289.5), the east service cases [883.6,144.7,891.0,211.5]/[880.6,219.8,891.2,242.1]/[878.8,242.5,890.7,264.7] whose fronts face the Market aisle x=891..927, and on the north the case run [765.1,118.5,831.6,128.9] with the diagonal (795.6,133.9)-(811.5,150.2). Two DRAWN DOUBLE SWING DOORS prove it is a room, not an alcove: one in the NE diagonal band at (863..876, 111..124) (two leaves + quarter-circle arcs, cf. store 269's staff doors) and one across the west wall's south end at (803.5..815.2, 298.3..301.8). Its only floor opening is the 23 pt staff mouth at x=831.6..855 onto the back alley, sealed here flush with the case line y=118.4. Customers are served from the east case fronts, which stay walkable

Cooking Connection demo-kitchen counter interior (staff inside the horseshoe). The counter is the U poly with outer bounds x 917.5-957.0 / y 252.3-292.5 and inner faces at x=921.5 and x=953.0; its mouth faces north but is plugged by the Market case [927.2,105.3,946.5,249.6], leaving only two ~6 pt slots at x 921.5-927.2 and x 946.5-953.0 (y 249.6-253.1) — no shopper walks in. The pipeline cannot condemn it itself: 'Cooking' (916.3,290.6) and 'Connection' (908.3,301.7) are ordinary text spans but extract.py's anchor whitelist carries no COOKING entry, so engine.SERVICE_DEPTS' COOKING token never matches an anchor (same dead-token cause documented on stores 24 and 660)

Sushiya sushi-bar counter interior (staff inside the horseshoe). The bar is the rotated U poly with inner contour (954.8,480.8)-(940.4,467.2)-(939.9,459.2)-(948.9,449.8)-(957.1,449.7)-(971.0,462.8); staff work inside the legs and customers stand outside them on the Market prepared-foods floor. Same dead-token cause as Cooking Connection: 'Sushiya' is real text at (953.6,465.3) but SUSHI is not in extract.py's anchor whitelist, so the SUSHI entry in engine.SERVICE_DEPTS can never fire here (cf. stores 24 and 265). Traced 2 pt outside the inner contour so no 1-cell sliver survives inside the ring
